sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Dear Omar
sections.intro: The first advice page in the school newsletter.
paragraphs: I came to Boston three weeks ago. Everyone is friendly, but I'm homesick. I miss my family and my food, and in the evenings I feel lonely. What should I do?
First, you're not alone. Almost every student here feels like this in the first month. I was homesick for a year!
Call your family, but not every day, because it can make you sadder. Try to make one plan with a classmate every week: a walk, a coffee, a film.
Why don't you join the Friday music evening at Sam's café? It's free, and the people are kind.
And cook your favorite food from home. It's a good idea to invite someone: food is the best way to make friends.
I have an important exam in two weeks, and I'm very stressed. I study until two in the morning, and I drink a lot of coffee. I can't relax.
You should study, but you should also sleep! Your brain needs at least seven hours to remember things.
Try to study in short parts: forty-five minutes, then take a ten-minute break. Get some fresh air every day, even when it's cold.
And please, no coffee after 4 p.m. You can do it!

sections.title: Grammar: giving advice
look: **Why don't you join** the music evening?
**It's a good idea to invite** someone.

head: Example
rows: **It's a good idea to** get some fresh air.

rules: After **should** and **Why don't you**, use the verb without *to*: *Why don't you **call** her?*
After **try** and **It's a good idea**, use **to** + verb: *Try **to** relax.*
**advice** is uncountable: *some advice*, *a lot of advice* (not *an advice* or *advices*).
examples: Why don't you talk to your teacher?
Try to go to bed before midnight.
It's a good idea to make a study plan.
Can you give me some advice?

support.tr: Tavsiye vermenin yolları: You should … (…-melisin), Why don't you …? (Neden … -mıyorsun? = …-sana, öneri), Try to … (…-meye çalış), It's a good idea to … (…-mek iyi bir fikir). should ve Why don't you'dan sonra to yok; try ve good idea'dan sonra to var. advice sayılamaz: an advice veya advices denmez; some advice denir.
support.ar: طرق تقديم النصيحة: You should … (من الأفضل أن)، Why don't you …? (لماذا لا …؟ = اقتراح)، Try to … (حاول أن …)، It's a good idea to … (من الجيد أن …). بعد should و Why don't you لا نضع to، وبعد try و good idea نضع to. كلمة advice غير معدودة: لا نقول an advice ولا advices، بل some advice.

tr.note: advice sayılamaz; Why don't you'dan sonra to yok.

sections.title: Write: A letter and an answer

model.heading: Dear Omar — and the answer
text: Dear Omar, I want to get fit, but I hate running, and the gym is too expensive. — Lazy Lucas
You don't need a gym! Try to walk to school every day. It's only twenty minutes.
Why don't you take the stairs, not the elevator?
It's also a good idea to dance. You love dancing!
And you should go to bed earlier, so you have more energy.
